newsitem.title: USA: Tarrant says it is hit with lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Tarrant says it is hit with lawsuit.

text.p: Tarrant Apparel Group said Thursday that it and two of its officers were named in a civil suit brought by the American Textile Manufacturers Institute.
The defendant officers are Gerard Guez, chairman and chief executive, and Todd Kay, president.
The company said the suit was filed in U.S. District Court for the District of Los Angeles.
Limited Inc of Columbus, Ohio and its subsidiary Mast Industries Inc of Andover, Mass., were also named as co-defendants, Tarrant said.
A spokesman for Limited could not be immediately reached for comment.
The lawsuit alleges, among other things, that the defendants filed improper statements about the country of origin of imported merchandise with the United States Customs Service, Tarrant said.
The complaint seeks unspecified monetary damages, Tarrant says.
Tarrant said it has monitoring procedures to ensure strict compliance with requirements of the U.S. Customs Service and the company does not tolerate violation of any law.
